notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> TMO coating on PP (six oxides) -> coating -> screen: dual-layer dendrite-free Li (n5) -> down-select MnO -> Li contact/plating -> MnO reduced to Mn0+Li2O -> Mn0/Li2O SEI on plated Li -> nucleation/self-healing mechanism -> dual-layer deposit -> CE and symmetric-cell stability -> Li||LFP and Li@Cu||LFP -> conclusion. Side: Mn0 beneath SEI surface (n11), PP dendritic control (n20), current-density size trend (n22, n24), dissolution-migration (n23). Audits: a1 (F3h Mn 2p labels ~8 eV apart with inverted ratio vs F2c doublet ~12 eV; qualifies Mn0-in-SEI), a2 (F8a MnO/PP without LiNO3 below the LiNO3-containing PP control). Lost: Figures S1-S21 (CE of oxide screen, Mn-on-Cu EDS, nucleation overpotential, DFT enthalpy) are text-only and kept in attrs, not as OBS.
